chunks.text: Hello guys, welcome to The Indian Kitchen Today I am going to show you how to make Prawns Fry If you like my recipe, please like and subscribe to my channel We have already washed the prawns Now we will add the masala According to taste, we will add salt Ginger garlic paste Green chilli chutney Mint leaves, green chilli Green chilli chutney Salt Cumin seeds Cumin seeds Cumin seeds Chutney 1 tsp according to taste 1 tsp coriander powder 1 tsp turmeric 1 tsp garam masala 1 tsp red chilli powder 1 tsp lemon juice Mix it well Keep it aside for 15-20 minutes After 20 minutes, we will add corn flour This will make the prawns crispy 3 tsp corn flour 1 tsp semolina This will make the prawns crispy Mix it well Oil is heated Now we will add the prawns Fry it Fry it for 2-3 minutes Fry it for 2-3 minutes After 4-5 minutes, the prawns are fried Now we will take it out This is the masala If you want, I will tell you the recipe It is very tasty If you haven't subscribed to our channel yet, please do it If you haven't subscribed to our channel yet, please do it
